evidence: GLOBAL RULE: tests/scored/functional/prompt.md:17 'Every refusal leg needs its own positive control: a successful action of the same kind, observed in this session.' prompt.md:25 requires, for every role replay, 'Send the same fresh request as Rafael afterwards (or before, on another card) as its control', excludes refusals caused only by staleness/duplicate/skip/full stage, and for inexpressible forbidden targets passes only 'when the card is unchanged and the allowed action of the same kind succeeded as its control'. prompt.md:29 makes 'does not appear/does not change' timed negatives watch the full 15 s and reconfirm in a fresh context. prompt.md:17 also zeros a criterion on a blank/static shell or failed backend gate. PER-CRITERION PAIRING (functional judge.toml): hro_intake_restart:33 blank title/places 0,51,2.5/recruiter-as-manager refusals vs J1/J2 opened; invalid and case-duplicate email refusals vs 'the same address on J2 is accepted' and A-F added; 'seeded jobs appear once' vs seeded board read in step 1. hro_moves:42 skips refused vs one-stage moves work. hro_reject_reopen:51 blank reason vs rejection with reason; wrong-stage reopens vs reopen to rejected-from stage; 'reason is gone' vs reason readable before; Hired-reject refused vs D advanced to Hired; full-Interview reopen refused vs 'once a place is free F reopens'. hro_two_people:60 409 refusal 'The original move is the control'. hro_interview_places:69 'A and B entering Interview are the control'; refused undo vs 'once a place is free the same undo goes ahead'. hro_bulk:78 'steps 3, 6 and 9 are the control'. hro_undo:87 repeated/interfered undo refusals vs step 1/3 undo and step 5 undo that 'goes ahead'. hro_activity:96 'refused attempts added no line' vs lines for every success; 'If no stage move succeeded in this session, this criterion is 0'. hro_manager_roles:105 Ingrid refusals vs her late-stage successes and 'Rafael's identical requests are the control'; Bill refusals vs 'Ingrid's move and Rafael's note are the controls'. hro_readonly_roles:114 403/401/404 refusals vs 'the Observer's board and Tomas's list load' and 'Rafael's requests succeeded'; 'if no kind has a successful control, this criterion is 0'. hro_messaging:123 blank refused / Ingrid not listed / send replays refused vs 'Rafael's own read and send are the controls'. hro_long_thread:141 'does not move his place' vs notice within 15 s and becomes read after going to it. hro_unread_seen:150 'does not raise either' vs earlier rise by exactly two; 'still not seen after only the Observer' vs seen after Tomas opens. hro_candidate:159 'no response contains...' vs own applications/statuses/conversations shown and 'A candidate page that receives none of its own data makes this criterion 0'; staff-read replay refused 'while Rafael's identical read succeeded'. POLISH: hro_pol_failed_send:52 nothing sent vs 'send again: it is sent once'; hro_pol_session_resume:61 'nothing was sent' vs 'the same conversation's reply ... sends, which is the positive control', Mei sees no drafts vs Rafael's drafts still there; hro_pol_live_board/live_thread zero the row 'If no update arrives within 60 seconds'. GATES: render judge.toml:51 incorrect password refused paired with correct sign-in (render prompt.md:9 'A valid sign-in immediately after the invalid attempt is the required positive control'); constraints gate is entirely positive (add, reload, Observer reads card). Visual is Likert craft with no negative legs. A blank app, empty database or login screen fails every criterion above. LESSONS FILE: lesson 6 checker-not-fixer present (functional prompt.md:7); lesson 9 step reporting with skipped-step fail present (prompt.md:31-33); lesson 7/14 timed negatives with void handling (prompt.md:29); lesson 15 multi-record restart re-read (hro_intake_restart:33). No instance of a lesson pattern undermining a positive control was found. ADVISORIES (not defects under the skill's Defect definition, because a broken app still cannot earn the criterion): (a) hro_candidate:159 privacy leg searches candidate responses for the suffixed rejection reason and for internal notes, but the criterion never has staff read back that the suffixed reason (or any note on Tomas's/Noor's cards) is actually stored in this session; an app that silently discards rejection reasons passes that sub-leg vacuously. Reason storage itself is graded in hro_reject_reopen, the seeded note on APP-101 (seed_data.json notes[0]) gives the notes leg a known positive fact, and the rest of hro_candidate still requires working candidate data, so the impact is bounded. (b) hro_manager_roles:105 says 'Rafael's identical requests are the control' for Ingrid's Interview-to-Screen, Applied re-order and Screen-rejection reopen refusals, but the Steps do not list those Rafael actions; prompt.md:25 obliges the judge to send them as controls, and Ingrid's own backward (Hired to Offer), re-order and reopen successes already prove each action kind works. RUNTIME: this row is a rubric-design check; scripted golden observations (raw-evidence-index entries, hashes verified) exist, but no configured judge run, Oracle or model score was measured, so no claim is made about judge adherence to these controls.
counterexample: Weak app that stores no rejection reason: on hro_candidate the 'no rejection reason in any candidate response' sub-leg passes by absence because nothing staff-side in the same session confirms the suffixed reason exists. It cannot earn the whole criterion without working candidate applications, statuses and conversations, and it loses hro_reject_reopen.
suggested_fix: Optional hardening: in hro_candidate add 'as Rafael read the suffixed reason and an internal note you add on Tomas's new card (the control)' before searching candidate responses, and in hro_manager_roles list Rafael's Interview-to-Screen, Applied re-order and Screen-rejection reopen as explicit control steps.
